description: This file defines a React component called RoleCard that renders an interactive UI card for displaying role information in a career/navigation application. It includes hover and select interactions, various styling, and leverages other components such as CompatibilityScore. It also provides a SkeletonCard component for placeholder UI.

methods.name: RoleCard
methods.description: React component that renders a card representing a role with interactive hover and selection features.

methods.name: SkeletonCard
methods.description: Component rendering a placeholder skeleton for the role card UI.
